# Country scope. True when country has built or holds an Ever-Normal Granary network.
oe_econ2_has_granary_network = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_econ2_has_ever_normal_granary
		any_owned_location = {
			has_building = building_type:oe_econ2_ever_normal_granary
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True when facing famine, vanilla Little Ice Age, or v12.5 Little Ice Age / Silver crises.
oe_econ2_needs_granary_relief = {
	OR = {
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution
		is_situation_active = situation:little_ice_age
		any_province = { is_starving = yes }
		has_country_modifier = oe_econ2_grain_corridor_shock
	}
}

# Location scope. O(1) check that a hub or grain node is owned, unlooted, and not under siege.
oe_econ2_node_healthy = {
	has_owner = yes
	is_looted = no
	has_siege = no
}
